description: Optional WebGPU features requested when the adapter offers them. Order is contract: float32-filterable, then timestamp-query (#1007 always-on when available), then one subgroup variant. Mirrors collectOptionalDeviceFeatures() and wasm_renderer/device.cpp.

tier2.note: Capability tier 2 (#1512), TypeScript only: requested after the three above when the adapter offers them and recorded in window.webgpuProbe (shaderF16, bgra8unormStorage, float32Blendable, dualSourceBlending). shader-f16 enables the `// @requires f16` variant of _half.wgsl; bgra8unorm-storage lets the present pass write a bgra8unorm swapchain from compute; float32-blendable and dual-source-blending are recorded for render-pass blending of float layers (the layer compositor itself is a compute pass and needs neither). The WASM backend is frozen and does not request them.
